title: AMD FY2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: segment structure change in Q2 FY2022
key_points: During the second quarter of fiscal year 2022 AMD changed its reporting segments to align financial reporting with how the CODM manages strategic end markets.
AMD reports performance based on four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.
Because of this change, the FY2021 comparatives shown in the FY2022 10-K are restated/recast to the new four-segment structure rather than the structure used in the FY2021 10-K.
raw_excerpt: During the second quarter of fiscal year 2022, we changed our reporting segments to align our financial reporting with how we manage our business in strategic end markets. This is consistent with how our Chief Operating Decision Maker (CODM) assesses our financial performance and allocates resources. As a result, we report our financial performance based on the following four reportable segments: Data Center, Client, Gaming, and Embedded.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Management attribution of the 10% Client revenue decline
key_points: Client net revenue decreased 10% in FY2022 versus FY2021.
